sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(total_runs) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS average_runs_per_match
FROM deliveries

SELECT 
    batter,
    ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 4 OR batsman_runs = 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / SUM(batsman_runs), 2) AS boundary_percentage
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY batter
HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 500
ORDER BY boundary_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT batter) 
FROM (
  SELECT batter, SUM(batsman_runs) as total_runs
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY batter
  HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 1000
) AS players_with_1000_runs

SELECT bowler, COUNT(*) as ball_count
FROM deliveries
WHERE extras_type IS NULL OR extras_type = 'NA'
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY ball_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT batter, SUM(batsman_runs) as total_runs
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY match_id, batter
ORDER BY total_runs DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT winner AS team, COUNT(*) AS wins
FROM matches m
JOIN deliveries d ON m.id = d.match_id
WHERE m.toss_decision = 'field' AND m.winner = m.team2
   OR m.toss_decision = 'bat' AND m.winner = m.team1
GROUP BY winner
ORDER BY wins DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(total_runs) AS total_powerplay_runs
FROM deliveries
WHERE over BETWEEN 0 AND 5

SELECT batter, SUM(batsman_runs) as total_runs
FROM deliveries
WHERE over >= 15 AND over <= 19
GROUP BY batter
ORDER BY total_runs DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    batter,
    ROUND((SUM(batsman_runs) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)), 2) AS strike_rate
FROM deliveries
WHERE extras_type != 'wides' OR extras_type IS NULL
GROUP BY batter
HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 300
ORDER BY strike_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    bowler,
    CAST(SUM(total_runs) AS FLOAT) / CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN extras_type NOT IN ('wides', 'noballs') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 6 AS economy
FROM deliveries
WHERE extras_type NOT IN ('wides', 'noballs')
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN extras_type NOT IN ('wides', 'noballs') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1000
ORDER BY economy ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    bowler,
    CAST(SUM(total_runs) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(*) AS bowling_average
FROM deliveries
WHERE is_wicket = 1 
    AND dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field')
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT season, batting_team AS team, SUM(total_runs) AS runs
FROM matches m
JOIN deliveries d ON m.id = d.match_id
GROUP BY season, batting_team
ORDER BY season, runs DESC
GROUP BY season
ORDER BY season

SELECT 
    batter,
    CAST(SUM(total_runs) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS average_runs_per_match
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY batter
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) >= 30
ORDER BY average_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT winner, target_runs
FROM matches
WHERE result = 'runs'
ORDER BY target_runs DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    bowler,
    COUNT(*) as wicket_count
FROM deliveries
WHERE 
    over >= 15 
    AND over <= 19
    AND is_wicket = 1
    AND dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field')
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY wicket_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT batter, COUNT(*) as balls_faced
FROM deliveries
WHERE batter NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT player_dismissed 
    FROM deliveries 
    WHERE player_dismissed IS NOT NULL
)
GROUP BY batter
ORDER BY balls_faced DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE 
        WHEN (toss_winner = winner AND toss_decision = 'field') 
        THEN 1 
        ELSE 0 
    END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM matches
WHERE winner IS NOT NULL

SELECT 
    winner AS team,
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT) * 100 / (
        SELECT COUNT(*) 
        FROM matches 
        WHERE season = '2023' 
        AND (team1 = m.winner OR team2 = m.winner)
    ) AS win_percentage
FROM matches m
WHERE season = '2023' 
AND winner IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY winner
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY win_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    bowler,
    player_dismissed AS batter,
    COUNT(*) AS dismissal_count
FROM deliveries
WHERE is_wicket = 1 
    AND dismissal_kind IS NOT NULL 
    AND dismissal_kind != 'run out'
GROUP BY bowler, player_dismissed
ORDER BY dismissal_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(first_innings_total) AS average_first_innings_total
FROM (
    SELECT m.id, SUM(d.total_runs) AS first_innings_total
    FROM matches m
    JOIN deliveries d ON m.id = d.match_id
    WHERE d.inning = 1
    AND m.result = 'wickets'
    AND m.winner != m.team1
    GROUP BY m.id
) AS first_innings_totals

SELECT CAST(SUM(total_runs) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS avg_runs_per_match
FROM deliveries

SELECT 
    batter,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs IN (4, 6) THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) / SUM(batsman_runs), 2) AS boundary_percentage
FROM deliveries
WHERE batsman_runs > 0
GROUP BY batter
HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 500
ORDER BY boundary_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM (
  SELECT batter, SUM(batsman_runs) as total_runs
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY batter
  HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 1000
)

SELECT bowler, COUNT(*) as legal_deliveries
FROM deliveries
WHERE extras_type IS NULL OR extras_type NOT IN ('wides', 'noballs')
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY legal_deliveries DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT batter, SUM(batsman_runs) as total_runs
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY match_id, batter
ORDER BY total_runs DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    m.winner AS team,
    COUNT(*) AS wins
FROM matches m
JOIN deliveries d ON m.id = d.match_id
WHERE d.inning = 1 
    AND m.winner IS NOT NULL
    AND m.winner != d.batting_team
GROUP BY m.winner
ORDER BY wins DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(total_runs) as total_powerplay_runs
FROM deliveries
WHERE over >= 0 AND over <= 5

SELECT 
    batter,
    SUM(batsman_runs) as total_runs
FROM deliveries
WHERE over >= 15 AND over <= 19
GROUP BY batter
ORDER BY total_runs DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    batter,
    ROUND(SUM(batsman_runs) * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN extras_type != 'wides' OR extras_type IS NULL THEN 1 END), 2) AS strike_rate
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY batter
HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 300
ORDER BY strike_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    bowler,
    ROUND((SUM(batsman_runs) + SUM(extra_runs)) * 6.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS economy
FROM deliveries
WHERE extras_type IS NULL OR extras_type NOT IN ('wides', 'noballs')
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000
ORDER BY economy ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    bowler,
    ROUND(CAST(SUM(batsman_runs + extra_runs) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(CASE WHEN is_wicket = 1 AND dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END), 2) AS bowling_average
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN is_wicket = 1 AND dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) >= 30
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    m.season,
    d.batting_team AS team,
    SUM(d.total_runs) AS runs
FROM deliveries d
JOIN matches m ON d.match_id = m.id
GROUP BY m.season, d.batting_team
HAVING SUM(d.total_runs) = (
    SELECT MAX(total_runs_per_team)
    FROM (
        SELECT SUM(d2.total_runs) AS total_runs_per_team
        FROM deliveries d2
        JOIN matches m2 ON d2.match_id = m2.id
        WHERE m2.season = m.season
        GROUP BY d2.batting_team
    )
)
ORDER BY m.season

SELECT 
    batter,
    CAST(SUM(batsman_runs) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS avg_runs_per_match
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY batter
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) >= 30
ORDER BY avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    m.winner AS winning_team,
    SUM(d.total_runs) AS runs
FROM matches m
JOIN deliveries d ON m.id = d.match_id
WHERE d.inning = 2 
    AND m.winner = d.batting_team
GROUP BY m.id, m.winner
ORDER BY runs DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT bowler, COUNT(*) as wicket_count
FROM deliveries
WHERE over BETWEEN 15 AND 19
  AND is_wicket = 1
  AND dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field')
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY wicket_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    batter,
    COUNT(*) as balls_faced
FROM deliveries
WHERE batter NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT player_dismissed 
    FROM deliveries 
    WHERE player_dismissed IS NOT NULL
)
GROUP BY batter
ORDER BY balls_faced DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN toss_winner = winner AND toss_decision = 'field' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
        2
    ) AS percentage
FROM matches
WHERE winner IS NOT NULL

WITH team_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    team,
    COUNT(*) as matches_played,
    SUM(CASE WHEN winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wins
  FROM (
    SELECT team1 as team, winner FROM matches WHERE season = '2023'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT team2 as team, winner FROM matches WHERE season = '2023'
  )
  GROUP BY team
  HAVING matches_played >= 5
)
SELECT 
  team,
  ROUND(100.0 * wins / matches_played, 2) as win_percentage
FROM team_stats
ORDER BY win_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    bowler,
    player_dismissed AS batter,
    COUNT(*) AS dismissal_count
FROM deliveries
WHERE is_wicket = 1 
    AND player_dismissed IS NOT NULL
    AND dismissal_kind IN ('bowled', 'caught', 'lbw', 'stumped', 'caught and bowled', 'hit wicket')
GROUP BY bowler, player_dismissed
ORDER BY dismissal_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(first_innings_total) as average_first_innings_total
FROM (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        SUM(d.total_runs) as first_innings_total
    FROM deliveries d
    JOIN matches m ON d.match_id = m.id
    WHERE d.inning = 1
      AND m.result = 'wickets'
    GROUP BY d.match_id
)

SELECT CAST(SUM(total_runs) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS avg_runs_per_match
FROM deliveries

WITH batter_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batter,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 4 THEN 4 WHEN batsman_runs = 6 THEN 6 ELSE 0 END) AS boundary_runs
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY batter
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT
    batter,
    total_runs,
    boundary_runs,
    CAST(boundary_runs AS REAL) * 100.0 / total_runs AS boundary_pct
  FROM batter_stats
  WHERE total_runs >= 500
)
SELECT
  batter,
  boundary_pct
FROM filtered
ORDER BY boundary_pct DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_players
FROM (
    SELECT batter, SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs
    FROM deliveries
    GROUP BY batter
    HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 1000
) AS t

SELECT
  bowler,
  COUNT(*) AS legal_deliveries
FROM deliveries
WHERE extras_type NOT IN ('wides', 'wides ', 'no ball', 'no balls', 'noball', 'no_ball')
   OR extras_type IS NULL
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY legal_deliveries DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  batter,
  SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY match_id, batter
ORDER BY runs DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
    d1.batting_team AS team,
    COUNT(*) AS wins
FROM matches m
JOIN deliveries d1
  ON m.id = d1.match_id
 AND d1.inning = 1
JOIN deliveries d2
  ON m.id = d2.match_id
 AND d2.inning = 2
GROUP BY m.id
HAVING m.winner = d2.batting_team
GROUP BY d2.batting_team
ORDER BY wins DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(total_runs) AS total_powerplay_runs
FROM deliveries
WHERE over BETWEEN 0 AND 5

SELECT
    batter,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs
FROM deliveries
WHERE "over" BETWEEN 15 AND 19
GROUP BY batter
ORDER BY total_runs DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH batter_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batter,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN extras_type = 'wides' THEN 0
        ELSE 1
      END
    ) AS legal_balls
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY batter
),
qualified AS (
  SELECT
    batter,
    runs,
    legal_balls,
    (CAST(runs AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / NULLIF(legal_balls, 0)) AS strike_rate
  FROM batter_stats
  WHERE runs >= 300
)
SELECT
  batter,
  strike_rate
FROM qualified
ORDER BY strike_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
    d.bowler,
    ROUND(
        SUM(d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.extras_type IN ('wides', 'noballs') THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END)
        / (COUNT(CASE WHEN d.extras_type NOT IN ('wides', 'noballs') OR d.extras_type IS NULL THEN 1 END) / 6.0),
        3
    ) AS economy
FROM deliveries d
WHERE d.extras_type IS NULL OR d.extras_type NOT IN ('wides', 'noballs')
GROUP BY d.bowler
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000
ORDER BY economy ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH bowler_stats AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    SUM(total_runs) AS runs_conceded,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN is_wicket = 1
         AND dismissal_kind NOT IN (
           'run out',
           'retired hurt',
           'retired out',
           'obstructing the field'
         )
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS wickets
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY bowler
),
qualified_bowlers AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    runs_conceded * 1.0 / wickets AS bowling_average
  FROM bowler_stats
  WHERE wickets >= 30
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  bowling_average
FROM qualified_bowlers
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH season_team_runs AS (
  SELECT
    m.season,
    d.batting_team AS team,
    SUM(d.total_runs) AS runs
  FROM deliveries d
  JOIN matches m ON d.match_id = m.id
  GROUP BY m.season, d.batting_team
),
season_max AS (
  SELECT
    season,
    MAX(runs) AS max_runs
  FROM season_team_runs
  GROUP BY season
)
SELECT
  s.season,
  s.team,
  s.runs
FROM season_team_runs s
JOIN season_max sm
  ON s.season = sm.season AND s.runs = sm.max_runs
ORDER BY s.season

SELECT
    d.batter,
    CAST(SUM(d.batsman_runs) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS avg_runs_per_match
FROM deliveries d
GROUP BY d.batter
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) >= 30
ORDER BY avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
    m.winner AS team,
    SUM(d.total_runs) AS runs
FROM matches m
JOIN deliveries d ON m.id = d.match_id
WHERE m.result = 'runs'
  AND m.target_runs IS NOT NULL
  AND d.inning = 2
GROUP BY m.id, m.winner
ORDER BY runs DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  bowler,
  COUNT(*) AS wickets
FROM deliveries
WHERE
  over BETWEEN 15 AND 19
  AND is_wicket = 1
  AND dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field')
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY wickets DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH dismissed_batters AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT player_dismissed AS batter
  FROM deliveries
  WHERE player_dismissed IS NOT NULL AND player_dismissed != ''
),
undismissed_balls AS (
  SELECT d.batter, COUNT(*) AS balls_faced
  FROM deliveries d
  LEFT JOIN dismissed_batters db
    ON d.batter = db.batter
  WHERE db.batter IS NULL
  GROUP BY d.batter
)
SELECT batter, balls_faced
FROM undismissed_balls
ORDER BY balls_faced DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(
      CASE 
        WHEN toss_decision = 'field' 
             AND toss_winner = winner 
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 
      END
    ) / COUNT(*)
  , 2) AS percentage_toss_winner_field_and_won
FROM matches

SELECT
    m.winner AS team,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) * 1.0 / tm.total_matches, 2) AS win_percentage
FROM matches m
JOIN (
    SELECT
        team,
        COUNT(*) AS total_matches
    FROM (
        SELECT season, team1 AS team FROM matches
        UNION ALL
        SELECT season, team2 AS team FROM matches
    ) t
    WHERE season = '2023'
    GROUP BY team
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
) tm
ON m.winner = tm.team
WHERE m.season = '2023'
GROUP BY m.winner, tm.total_matches
ORDER BY win_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  d.bowler,
  d.batter,
  COUNT(*) AS dismissals
FROM deliveries d
WHERE d.is_wicket = 1
  AND d.player_dismissed = d.batter
  AND d.dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field')
GROUP BY d.bowler, d.batter
ORDER BY dismissals DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(first_innings_total) AS avg_first_innings_total
FROM (
    SELECT
        m.id AS match_id,
        CASE
            WHEN d.batting_team = m.team1 THEN m.team2
            ELSE m.team1
        END AS chasing_team,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.inning = 1 THEN d.total_runs ELSE 0 END) AS first_innings_total
    FROM matches m
    JOIN deliveries d ON m.id = d.match_id
    GROUP BY m.id
) t
JOIN matches m2 ON t.match_id = m2.id AND t.chasing_team = m2.winner
